title: Rent Changes and Unit Transfers on the Apartment Home Lease Record
content:
The monthly rent and the apartment home on an Apartment Home Lease record change only through the Lease Term Agreement.

## Monthly rent

- The monthly rent is changed only to the new rent of a recorded rent change whose effective date has arrived. The rent change, its new rent and its effective date are read from the Lease Term Agreement's rent change record.
- A rent change is recorded only under the Lease Term Agreement charter (renewal, month-to-month conversion or transfer).
- It applies from the first billing period whose due date is on or after its effective date.

## Unit transfer

- A unit transfer rewrites the apartment home number, the floor plan, the monthly rent and the number of occupants only on a transfer signed under the Lease Term Agreement charter, and only when the destination floor plan admits the household:
  - the number of occupants does not exceed the destination floor plan's maximum occupants; and
  - when the destination rent is higher than the current monthly rent, the recorded gross monthly income is at least the destination floor plan's minimum income multiple times the destination rent.
- The lease keeps its lease reference, ledger, balance and Security Deposit Account across a transfer, and a transfer never earns a new move-in concession.

## Admission test for a transfer

| Occupants within the destination maximum | Destination rent higher than current rent | Income at least the destination multiple times destination rent | Household admitted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | not tested | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | Yes | No | No |
| No | any | any | No |

## Hypothetical cases

- A household of 4 moving to a floor plan whose maximum is 3 occupants is not admitted, whatever the rent.
- A household with recorded income of $7,200.00 moving to a destination rent of $2,500.00 on a floor plan with a multiple of 3.00 needs $7,500.00 and is not admitted; at a destination rent of $2,400.00 it needs exactly $7,200.00 and is admitted.
- A move to a cheaper apartment home is not income-tested.
- A renewal with a new rent effective 1 July applies from the July billing period.
